resources.string: Use English or Roman Hindi/Hinglish, up to 4,000 characters. Devanagari is not supported in this version.

Only text you ask to translate is sent through our translation server to Google\'s Gemini API. Under Google\'s free tier, content may be reviewed by people and used to improve its products. Please don\'t translate sensitive or confidential text. We don\'t save translation text or results. Our server stores total request counts to limit usage. No account or sign-in is needed.
No internet connection. Connect and try again.
Translation is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
That took too long. Try again.
Couldn\'t reach the translation service. Try again.
Got an unexpected response. Try again.

Write: select your draft and choose Lingo-Translate to replace it automatically.
Read: select a message and choose Lingo-Translate for a floating English result. English and Roman Hindi/Hinglish only.

Automatic copy prompts on modern Android require Lingo keyboard to be enabled and selected as your keyboard. This is a basic Roman keyboard without predictions. Typing stays on your phone.
With another keyboard, copy a message and tap the Lingo bubble to translate it.

Writing works independently of reading sessions and keyboard choice, in apps that expose Android text-selection actions. A successful translation replaces only the selected draft. Cancel or failure leaves the draft unchanged.
Lingo keyboard selected: copy prompts are available during a reading session.
Other keyboard selected: copy a message, then tap the Lingo bubble. Automatic clipboard detection is restricted by Android.
Floating translations could not start. Allow display over other apps and try again. This phone or app may restrict overlays.
Allow LingoTranslate to display over other apps so the English result can float over your current app.
Reading session started. Return to your chat or game.
Floating translation is active. Tap Stop to end the session.
Open reading translation or translate copied text. Drag to move.
Message copied. Translate it to English?
No readable English or Roman Hindi message found. Copy a text message and try again. Passwords, sensitive clips and unsupported text are skipped.
